    line = STDIN.gets.chomp.split(" ")

    queue[i] = process
  end

    process = queue.shift
    if process.time > q
      time += q
      process.time -= q
      queue.push(process)
    else
      time += process.time
      process.time -= process.time
      process.endtime = time
      processes_ended.push(process)
    end
  end
  processes_ended.each do |process|
    puts "#{process.name} #{process.endtime}"
  end

import           Control.Applicative
import           Control.Monad
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as B
import           Debug.Trace

readInt' :: B.ByteString -> Int
readInt' bs | Just (n, _) <- B.readInt bs = n

data Queue a =
    Queue [a]
          [a]
    deriving (Show)

enqueue :: a -> Queue a -> Queue a
enqueue x (Queue fs bs) = Queue fs (x:bs)

dequeue :: Queue a -> Maybe (a, Queue a)
dequeue (Queue [] []) = Nothing
dequeue (Queue [] (b:bs))
    | (c:cs) <- reverse (b : bs) = Just (c, Queue cs [])
dequeue (Queue (f:fs) bs) = Just (f, Queue fs bs)

isEmpty :: Queue a -> Bool
isEmpty (Queue [] []) = True
isEmpty _             = False

fromList :: [a] -> Queue a
fromList xs = Queue xs []

solve :: Int -> Queue (B.ByteString, Int) -> IO ()
solve quontum queue = go 0 queue
  where
    go c que =
        case dequeue que of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just ((name, time), que') -> do
                if time <= quontum
                    then do
                        putStrLn $ B.unpack name ++ " " ++ show (c + time)
                        go (c + time) que'
                    else do
                        go (c + quontum) (enqueue (name, time - quontum) que')

main :: IO ()
main = do
    [n, q] <- fmap readInt' . B.words <$> B.getLine
    ps <- fmap ((\[a, b] -> (a, readInt' b)) . B.words)
          . B.lines <$> B.getContents
    let que = fromList ps
    solve q que

calc :: [(String, Int)] -> Int -> Int -> [String] -> [String]
calc [] _ _ ans = reverse ans
calc ((name, time):xs) n total ans
  | time > n = calc (xs ++ [(name, time - n)]) n (total + n) ans
  | otherwise = calc xs n (total + time) $ (unwords [name, show $ total + time]) : ans

import qualified Data.Sequence as S

type Process = (String, Int)
readProc :: IO Process
readProc = do
  [name, stime] <- fmap words getLine
  return (name, read stime)

process :: Int -> Seq Process -> Int -> IO ()
process rtt ps' e = case S.viewl ps' of
  S.EmptyL -> return ()
  ((n, t) :< ps) ->
    if (t > rtt) then
      process rtt (ps |> (n,t-rtt)) (e + rtt)
    else do
      putStrLn $ n ++ " " ++ show (e+t)
      process rtt ps (e+t)

main :: IO ()

  [n, rtt] <- fmap (map read . words) getLine
  procs <- S.replicateM n readProc
  process rtt procs 0

import Control.Applicative

type Process = (String, Int)

process :: Int -> Int -> Process -> (Int, Process)
process quantum elapsed (name, time)
  | time <= elapsed = (elapsed+time,    (name, 0))
  | otherwise       = (elapsed+quantum, (name, time-quantum))

processAndPrint :: Int -> Int -> [Process] -> IO ()
processAndPrint _ _ [] = return ()
processAndPrint quantum elapsed (p:ps) = do
  let (elapsed', p'@(name, time)) = process quantum elapsed p
  if time == 0
     then do
       putStrLn $ name ++ " " ++ show elapsed'
       processAndPrint quantum elapsed' ps
     else
       processAndPrint quantum elapsed' (ps ++ [p'])

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n, q] <- map read . words <$> getLine :: IO [Int]
  processAndPrint q 0 =<< (getProcesses n)
  where

    getProcesses 0 = return []
    getProcesses n = do

    where

import Data.Array.ST
import Data.Array
import Data.STRef
import Control.Monad.ST
import Control.Monad

--head,tail,size,bodyArray
type Queue s a = (STRef s (Int,Int,Int),STArray s Int (Maybe a))

new_queue::Int->ST s (Queue s a)
new_queue size = do
  ar<-newArray (0,size-1) Nothing
  hts_pt<-newSTRef (0,0,size)
  return (hts_pt,ar)

is_empty::Queue s a -> ST s Bool
is_empty (hts_pt,ar) = do
  (h,t,s)<-readSTRef hts_pt
  return (if h==t then True else False)

is_full::Queue s a -> ST s Bool
is_full (hts_pt,ar) = do
  (h,t,s)<-readSTRef hts_pt
  return (if mod (t+1) s == h then True else False)

de_queue::Queue s a -> ST s a
de_queue (hts_pt,ar) = do
  (h,t,s)<-readSTRef hts_pt
  (Just v)<-readArray ar h
  writeArray ar h Nothing
  writeSTRef hts_pt (mod (h+1) s,t,s)
  return v

en_queue::a -> Queue s a -> ST s ()
en_queue v (hts_pt,ar) = do
  (h,t,s)<-readSTRef hts_pt
  writeArray ar t (Just v)
  writeSTRef hts_pt (h,mod (t+1) s,s)
  return ()

show_queue::Queue s a -> ST s (Maybe (Array Int (Maybe a)))
show_queue (hts_pt,ar) = do
  b<-is_empty (hts_pt,ar)
  if b then return Nothing else do
                              iar<-freeze ar
                              return (Just iar)

--キュー、プロセス単位、現在時、完了履歴
do_proc::Queue s (String,Int) -> Int -> Int ->ST s [(String,Int)]
do_proc queue quant now = do
  b<-is_empty queue
  if b then return []
       else do
         (p_name,p_time) <- de_queue queue
         if p_time <= quant then do
              rest<-do_proc queue quant (now+p_time)
              return ((p_name,now+p_time):rest)
                            else do
              en_queue (p_name,p_time-quant) queue
              rest<-do_proc queue quant (now+quant)
              return rest

make_schedule::Int->[(String,Int)]->ST s (Queue s (String,Int))
make_schedule n ls = do
  queue<-new_queue n
  forM_ ls (\ i -> en_queue i queue)
  return queue

type Queue a = ([a],[a])

enQueue :: Monad m => a -> StateT (Queue a) m ()
enQueue x = get >>= \(as,xs) -> put ((as, x:xs))

deQueue :: Monad m => StateT (Queue a) m a
deQueue = do
        (as, xs) <- get
        if null as then do
                       let xs' = reverse xs
                       put (tail xs', [])
                       return $ head xs'
                   else do
                       put (tail as, xs)
                       return $ head as

isEmpty :: Monad m => StateT (Queue a) m Bool
isEmpty = do
        (as,xs) <- get
        return $ null as && null xs


data Process = P { name :: String
                 , time :: Int } deriving (Show)

process :: [String] -> Process
process [x,y] = P x (read y)

setProcess :: [String] -> Queue Process
setProcess pstrings = execState action ([],[])
        where ps = map (process.words) $ pstrings
              action = sequence_ $ map enQueue ps

roundRobin :: Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
roundRobin q = do
        t <- get
        p <- lift deQueue
        runProcess q p t
        emptyCheck
        where emptyCheck = do
                empty <- lift isEmpty
                if empty then return ()
                         else roundRobin q

runProcess :: Int -> Process -> Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
runProcess q p t
    | q >= time p = do
        liftIO (putStrLn $ unwords [name p, show (t+time p)])
        modify (+ time p)
    | otherwise   = do
        let p' = p {time = time p - q}
        modify (+ q)
        lift $ enQueue p'

roundRobin :: [(String, Int)] -> [(String, Int)] -> UnitTime -> TotalTime -> [(String, Int)]
roundRobin [] ys _ _ = ys
roundRobin (x:xs) ys u t
  | (snd x) == consume = roundRobin xs ((fst x, total):ys) u total
  | otherwise          = roundRobin (xs ++ [(fst x, snd x - consume)]) ys u total
  where consume = min (snd x) u
        total = t + consume

type Queue a = ([a], Int, [a], Int)

empty' :: Queue a
empty' = ([], 0, [], 0)

isEmpty' :: Queue a -> Bool
isEmpty' (_, 0, _, _) = True
isEmpty' _ = False

head' :: Queue a -> a
head' (x : _, _, _, _) = x
head' _ = error "the queue is empty"

check :: Queue a -> Queue a
check q@(f, fl, t, tl)
  | fl < tl = (f ++ reverse t, fl + tl, [], 0)
  | otherwise = q

tail' :: Queue a -> Queue a
tail' (_ : f, fl, t, tl) = check (f, fl - 1, t, tl)
tail' _ = error "the queue is empty"

snoc' :: Queue a -> a -> Queue a
snoc' (f, fl, t, tl) x = check (f, fl, x : t, tl + 1)

import qualified Data.Vector         as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Mutable as VM
import Control.Applicative
import Control.Monad
import Data.IORef
import Text.Printf

type Process = (String, Int)

roundRobin :: Int -> [Process] -> IO ()
roundRobin q xs = do
  queue <- V.thaw $ V.fromList (xs ++ [("String", 0)])
  front <- newIORef 0
  rear  <- newIORef $ length xs
  loop q 0 queue front rear
  where
    n = length xs
    loop q t queue front rear = do
      f <- readIORef front
      r <- readIORef rear
      when (f /= r) $ do
        i <- readIORef front
        writeIORef front (if i == n then 0 else i + 1)
        (name, time) <- VM.read queue i
        if time <= q
          then do
          printf "%s %d\n" name (t + time)
          loop q (t + time) queue front rear
          else do
          j <- readIORef rear
          writeIORef rear (if j == n then 0 else j + 1)
          VM.write queue j (name, time - q)
          loop q (t + q) queue front rear

                 , time :: Int } deriving (Show)

process :: [String] -> Process
process [x,y] = P x (read y)

setProcess :: [String] -> Queue Process
setProcess pstrings = execState action ([],[])
        where ps = map (process.words) $ pstrings

roundRobin :: Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
roundRobin q = do
        t <- get
        p <- lift deQueue
        liftIO $ putStrLn "The Process to be run"
        liftIO $ print p
        runProcess q p t
        emptyCheck
        where emptyCheck = do
                empty <- lift isEmpty
                if empty then return ()
                         else roundRobin q

runProcess :: Int -> Process -> Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
runProcess q p t
    | q >= time p = do
        liftIO (putStrLn $ unwords [name p, show (t+time p)])
        modify (+ time p)
        liftIO $ putStrLn "The Process has been run (End)"
        liftIO $ print p
    | otherwise   = do
        let p' = p {time = time p - q}
        modify (+ q)
        lift $ enQueue p'
        liftIO $ putStrLn "The Process has been run"
        liftIO $ print p'

    innerSolve q elapsed que
      | queueEmpty que = []

enQueue x = get >>= \(as,xs) -> put ((as, x:xs))

deQueue :: Monad m => StateT (Queue a) m a
deQueue = do
        (as, xs) <- get
        if null as then do
                       let xs' = reverse xs
                       put (tail xs', [])
                       return $ head xs'
                   else do
                       put (tail as, xs)
                       return $ head as

roundRobin :: Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
roundRobin q = do
        t <- get
        p <- lift deQueue
        runProcess q p t
        emptyCheck
        where emptyCheck = do
                empty <- lift isEmpty
                if empty then return ()
                         else roundRobin q

runProcess :: Int -> Process -> Int -> StateT Int (StateT (Queue Process) IO) ()
runProcess q p t
    | q >= time p = do
        liftIO (putStrLn $ unwords [name p, show (t+time p)])
        modify (+ time p)
    | otherwise   = do
        let p' = p {time = time p - q}
        modify (+ q)
        lift $ enQueue p'

def get_input_as_hash(num)
  hash={}
  for i in 1..num
    line = readline.split(/[[:space:]]/)

  end
  hash

def queue_calc(hash,limit_time,totaltime=0)
  tmp_array=[]
  hash.each do |key,val|
    if val>limit_time
      hash[key] = val-limit_time
      tmp_array.push hash.assoc(key)
      hash.delete(key)
      totaltime += limit_time
    else
      hash[key]=val+totaltime
      totaltime = hash[key]
    end
  end
  if tmp_array.size!=0
    new_hash = {}
    #print tmp_array
    tmp_array.each do |hashset|
      new_hash.store(hashset[0],hashset[1])
    end
    new_hash = queue_calc(new_hash,limit_time,totaltime)
    hash.merge! new_hash
  end
  hash
end

def roundrobin(q, queue)
  finished = []
  t = 0
  while queue.size != 0
    process = queue.deque
    if (process[1].to_i <= q)
      t = t + process[1].to_i
      process[1] = 0
      finished.push("#{process[0]} #{t}")
    else
      t = t + q
      process[1] = process[1].to_i - q
      queue.enque(process)
    end
  end

  puts finished.join("\n")
end

class RoundRobinScheduling
  def initialize(processes, quantum)
    @processes = processes
    @quantum = quantum
    @total_time = 0
  end

  def execute
    while @processes.length > 0 do
      process = @processes.shift
      if process.time <= @quantum
        @total_time += process.time
        puts "#{process.name} #{@total_time}"
      else
        @total_time += @quantum
        process.time -= @quantum
        @processes << process
      end
    end
  end
end

class MyQueue
  def initialize(size)
    @head = @tail = 0
    @size = size
    @q = Array.new(size)
  end

  def empty?
    @head == @tail
  end

  def full?
    @head == (@tail + 1) % @size
  end

  def enqueue(x)
    if full?
      raise "overflow"
    end

    @q[@tail] = x
    if @tail + 1 == @size
      @tail = 0
    else
      @tail += 1
    end
  end

  def dequeue
    raise 'underflow' if empty?

    x = @q[@head]
    if @head + 1 == @size
      @head = 0
    else
      @head += 1
    end

    x
  end
end

class MyProcess
  attr_accessor :name, :time
  def initialize(name, time)
    @name = name
    @time = time
  end

  def proc(proc_time)
    if @time <= proc_time
      rest_time = proc_time - @time
      @time = 0
    else
      @time -= proc_time
      rest_time = 0
    end
    rest_time
  end

  def ended?
    time.zero?
  end
end

# A simple queue.
class Queue
  def initialize(capacity)
    @queue = Array.new capacity
    @head = @num = 0
  end

  def enq(item)
    raise 'Queue is full' if full?
    @num += 1
    tail = (@head + @num - 1) % @queue.size
    @queue[tail] = item
  end

  def deq
    raise 'Queue is empty' if empty?
    item = @queue[@head]
    @queue[@head] = nil
    @head = (@head + 1) % @queue.size
    @num -= 1
    item
  end

  def empty?
    @num == 0
  end

  def full?
    @num == @queue.size
  end
end

# A processor.
class CPU
  MAX_N_PROCESSES = 100000
  Process = Struct.new :name, :time

  def initialize(quantum)
    @quantum = quantum
  end

  def load_ps(n_ps)
    ps = Queue.new MAX_N_PROCESSES
    n_ps.times do
      input = gets.chomp.split
      process = Process.new input[0], input[1].to_i
      ps.enq process
    end
    ps
  end

  def run(ps)
    elapsed_time = 0

    until ps.empty?
      process = ps.deq
      if process.time <= @quantum
        elapsed_time += process.time
        puts "#{process.name} #{elapsed_time}"
      else
        elapsed_time += @quantum
        process.time -= @quantum
        ps.enq process
      end
    end
  end
end

class RingBuffer
  def initialize(cap)
    @cap = cap + 1
    @values = Array.new(@cap)
    @head = @tail = 0
  end

  def empty?
    @head == @tail
  end

  def full?
    @head == ((@tail + 1) % @cap)
  end

  def enq(value)
    raise 'buffer is full' if full?

    @values[@tail] = value
    @tail = (@tail + 1) % @cap
    nil
  end

  def deq
    raise 'buffer is empty' if empty?

    value = @values[@head]
    @head = (@head + 1) % @cap
    value
  end
end

class Queue
  attr_accessor :head, :tail, :queue

  def initialize(size)
    @head = 0
    @tail = 0
    @queue = Array.new(size)
  end

  def enqueue(x)
    @queue[@tail] = x
    if @tail + 1 == @queue.size
      @tail = 0
    else
      @tail += 1
    end
  end

  def dequeue
    x = @queue[@head]
    if @head + 1 == @queue.size
      @head = 0
    else
      @head += 1
    end
    return x
  end

  def isEmpty?
    return @head == @tail
  end

  def isFull?
    return @head == (@tail + 1) % @queue.size
  end
end

class Queue
  attr_accessor :head ,:tail ,:queue
  MAX = 50001

  def initialize()
    @queue = []
    @head  = 0
    @tail  = 0
  end

  def isEmpty?()
    return @head == @tail
  end

  def isFull?()
    return @head == (@tail + 1) % MAX
  end

  def enqueue(x)
    if isFull?
      puts "queue is full!"
      return -1
    end

    @queue[@tail] = x
    (@tail+1) == MAX ? @tail = 0 : @tail += 1
  end

  def dequeue()
    if isEmpty?
      puts "queue is empty!"
      return -1
    end
    x = @queue[@head]
    @queue[@head] = nil
    (@head+1) == MAX ? @head = 0 : @head += 1

    return x
  end
end

def roundRobin(q, process, time)
  currentTime = 0
  loop do
    break if process.empty?
    p = process.shift
    t = time.shift
    if t <= q
      currentTime += t
      puts p + " " + currentTime.to_s
    else
      t -= q
      process.push p
      time.push t
      currentTime += q
    end
  end
end

function RoundRobinScheduling (&$N, $TMAX, $A) {
  $arr = array();
  $total = 0;
  $br = '';
  $index = $N;
  $skip = true;
  while($index < $N || $skip) {
    if ($index >= $N) {
      $skip = false;
      $index = 0;
    }
    $v = &$A[$index];
    if (!$v) {
      $index++;
      continue;
    }
    $t = $v[1];
    if ($t <= $TMAX) {
      $total += $t;
      echo($br);
      if (!$br) {
        $br = "\n";
      }
      echo($v[0].' '.$total);
      $A[$index] = NULL;
    } else {
      $total += $TMAX;
      $v[1] = $t - $TMAX;
      $skip = true;
    }
    $index++;
  }
}

class Que{
  public $data=[];
  public $size=100000;
  public $head=0;
  public $tail=0;
  function init(){$this->head=$this->tail=0;}
  function isEmpty(){return $this->head==$this->tail;}
  function isFull(){return $this->head==($this->tail+1)%$this->size;}
  function push($x){
    if($this->isFull()) return false;
    $t=$this->tail;
    if(++$this->tail==$this->size) $this->tail=0;
    $this->data[$t]=$x;
  }
  function shift(){
    if($this->isEmpty()) return false;
    $h=$this->head;
    if(++$this->head==$this->size) $this->head=0;
    return $this->data[$h];
  }
}

function RoundRobinScheduling (&$N, $TMAX, $A) {
  $arr = array();
  $total = 0;
  $br = '';
  $index = $N;
  $skip = true;
  while($index < $N || $skip) {
    if ($index >= $N) {
      $skip = false;
      $index = 0;
    }
    $v = &$A[$index];
    if (!$v) {
      $index++;
      continue;
    }
    $t = $v[1];
    if ($t <= $TMAX) {
      $total += $t;
      echo($br);
      if (!$br) {
        $br = "\n";
      }
      echo($v[0].' '.$total);
      $A[$index] = NULL;
    } else {
      $total += $TMAX;
      $v[1] = $t - $TMAX;
      $skip = true;
    }
    $index++;
  }
}

        $this->_size = $size;
        $this->_queue = array_fill(0, $size, null);
        $this->_head = 0;

    }

    {
        $x = $this->_queue[$this->_head];
        $this->_head = ($this->_head + 1) % $this->_size;

    }

class Queue {
    private $q; 
    private $head; 
    private $tail; 
    private $max;

    public function __construct($max) {
	$this->q = array();
	$this->head = 0;
	$this->tail = 0;
	$this->max = $max;
	$this->count = 0;
    }

    public function isFull() {
	return $this->count >= $this->max;
    }

    public function isEmpty() {
	return $this->count == 0;
    }

	if ($this->isFull()) {echo "The queue is full.\n"; return false;}
	$this->q[$this->tail] = $v;

	    $this->tail = 0;
	} else {
	    $this->tail++;
	}
	$this->count++;
    }

	if ($this->isEmpty()) {echo "The queue is empty.\n"; return false;}
	$x = $this->q[$this->head];

	if ($this->head + 1 == $this->max) {
	    $this->head = 0;
	} else {
	    $this->head++;
	}
	$this->count--;
	
	return $x;
    }

	return $this->max;

	return $this->count;

    }

	return $this->tail = $tail;
    }
    public function setMax($max) {
	return $this->max = $max;
    }
    public function setCount($count) {
	return $this->count = $count;
    }
    public function setNewProcess($sec) {
	$this->q[$this->head]['sec'] = $sec;
    }

        }

        queue: queue
        head
        tail

        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 1000100
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_full():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Overflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].name = name
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].time = time
            self.tail += 1

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_empty():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Underflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].name = ""
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].time = 0
            self.head += 1

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False

def rrs(quantum, process):
    finished_process = []

    time_queue = Queue()
    name_queue = Queue()
    
    current_time = 0

    for name, time in process:
        time = int(time)
        time_queue.enqueue(time)
        name_queue.enqueue(name)

    while time_queue.data:
        time = time_queue.dequeue()
        name = name_queue.dequeue()
        if time <= quantum:
            current_time += time
            finished_process.append((name, current_time))
        else:
            current_time += quantum
            time_queue.enqueue(time - quantum)
            name_queue.enqueue(name)
            
    return finished_process

class RoundRobin(object):
    def __init__(self, n, q, names, times):
        self.n = n
        self.q = q
        self.size = 2 * n

        self.queue = [0] * self.size
        self.queue[:n] = [ ( names[i], int(times[i]) ) for i in range(n) ]
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = n

    def enqueue(self, x):
        self.queue[self.tail] = x
        self.tail = ( self.tail + 1 ) % self.size
        return

    def dequeue(self):
        x = self.queue[self.head]
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = ( self.head + 1 ) % self.size
        return x

    def execute(self):
        t = 0
        while 1:
            u = self.dequeue()
            if u[1] > self.q:
                t += self.q
                self.enqueue( (u[0], u[1] - self.q ) )
            else:
                t += u[1]
                print(u[0], t)
            if self.head == self.tail:
                break
        return

def initialize():
  global head, tail
  head = tail = 0

def isEmpty():
  global head, tail
  return head == tail

def isFull():
  global head, tail, max_i
  return head == (tail + 1) % max_i

def enqueue(x):
  if isFull():
    print('over flow')
  global head, tail
  Q[tail] = x
  if tail + 1 == max_i:
    tail = 0
  else:
    tail += 1

def dequeue():
  if isEmpty():
    print('under flow')
  global head, tail
  x = Q[head]
  if head + 1 == max_i:
    head = 0
  else:
    head += 1
  return x

    def __init__(self, queue_size):
        self.queue_size = queue_size
        self.Q = [None] * self.queue_size
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, x):

        self.tail = None

        self.size += 1
        n = Node(v)
        if self.tail == None:
            self.tail = n
        else:
            self.tail.next = n
            self.tail = n
        if self.head == None:
            self.head = self.tail

        if self.size == 0:
            print 'underflow'
            exit()
        self.size -= 1
        v = self.head.v
        self.head = self.head.next
        if self.head == None:
            self.tail = None
        return v

def round_robin_scheduling(process_name, process_time, q):
    result = []
    elapsed_time = 0

    while len(process_name) > 0:
        if process_time[0] <= q:
            elapsed_time += process_time[0]

def initQtable(Len_q):
    Q = [0 for i in range(Len_q+1)]
    return Q

def initPointer():
    head = tail = 0
    return head, tail

def isEmpty(head, tail):
    return head == tail

def isFull(head, tail, Len_q):
    return head == (tail+1)%Len_q

def enqueue(head, tail, Q, qname):
    Len_q = len(Q)
    if isFull(head, tail, Len_q):
        print("Error: Full Qtable")
        return
    tail = incrementPointer(tail, Len_q)
    Q[tail] = qname
    return tail
    
def dequeue(head, tail, Q):
    if isEmpty(head, tail):
        print("Error: Empty Qtable")
        return
    head = incrementPointer(head, Len_q+1)
    q = Q[head]
    return head, q

def incrementPointer(ptr, Len_q):
    ptr += 1
    if ptr >= Len_q:
        ptr = 0
    return ptr

from copy import deepcopy


def round_robin(l, q):
    work = deepcopy(l)
    res = []
    time = 0
    while len(work):
        if work[0][1] > q:
            work[0][1] -= q
            work.append(work.pop(0))
            l.append(l.pop(0))
            time += q
        else:
            time += work[0][1]
            work.pop(0)
            res.append(l.pop(0))
            res[-1][1] = time
    return res

from collections import deque


def run_process(processes, slot):
    """Simulate the round-robin scheduler.
    Returns a list of (process, elapsed_time).

    >>> ps = [('p1', 150), ('p2', 80), ('p3', 200), ('p4', 350), ('p5', 20)]
    >>> run_process(ps, 100)
    [('p2', 180), ('p5', 400), ('p1', 450), ('p3', 550), ('p4', 800)]
    """
    ps = deque(processes)
    tot = 0
    finish = []

    while len(ps) > 0:
        p, t = ps.popleft()
        dt = min(t, slot)
        if dt == t:
            finish.append((p, tot+dt))
        else:
            ps.append((p, t-dt))

        tot += dt

    return finish


def run():
    count, slot = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
    ps = []

    for _ in range(count):
        p, t = input().split()
        ps.append((p, int(t)))

    for p, t in run_process(ps, slot):
        print(p, t)

        in_process.pop(0)
        in_time.pop(0)

        self.length = 100010
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_full():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Overflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].name = name
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].time = time
            self.tail += 1

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_empty():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Underflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].name = ""
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].time = 0
            self.head += 1

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time

    result = []
    elapsed_time = 0

    while len(process_name) > 0:
        p_name = process_name.pop(0)
        p_time = process_time.pop(0)

        if p_time > quantum:

            process_time.append(p_time - quantum)
        else:
            elapsed_time += p_time
            result.append(p_name + ' ' + str(elapsed_time))

    return result

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50005
        self.queue = [0] * self.length
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    # def enqueue(self, name, time):
    def enqueue(self, process):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail] = process
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time,):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    # value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].forward_time(interval)
    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head] - interval

        current_time += (interval + value)

        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        my_queue.enqueue(my_queue.queue[my_queue.head])
        my_queue.dequeue()

    return current_time

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50010
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail].name = name
        self.queue[self.tail].time = time
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.head].name = ""
        self.queue[self.head].time = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        name, time = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, \
                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].time
        my_queue.dequeue()
        my_queue.enqueue(name, time)

    return current_time

            time += q

            self._head = 0
        ret = self._queue[self._head][::]
        self._head += 1

        self._queue[self._tail] = x

class queue():
    def __init__(self,size,q):
        self.time={}
        self.finishlist=[]
        self.S=[None]*size
        self.q=q
        self.under=0#最後の要素
    def print(self):
        print(self.under)

    def enqueue(self,x):#FI
        self.under+=1
        self.S[self.under]=x
    def unqueue(self):#FO
        self.under-=1
        vari=self.S[1]
        del self.S[1]
        self.S.append(None)
        return vari
    def isEmpty(self):
        return self.under!=0
    def calc(self):
        alltime=0
        while(self.isEmpty()):
            process=self.unqueue()
            da=int(process[1])
            if int(process[1])>self.q:
                # if process[0] not in self.time:
                #     self.time[process[0]]=self.q
                # else:
                #     self.time[process[0]] += self.q
                alltime+=self.q
                da-=self.q
                (process[1])=str(da)
                self.enqueue(process)
            else:#処理終了
                alltime+=int(process[1])
                self.time[process[0]] = alltime


                self.finishlist.append(process[0])
        return self.time,self.finishlist

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50010
        self.queue = [0] * self.length
        # counter = 0
        # while counter < self.length:
        #     self.queue.append(Process())
        #     counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    # def enqueue(self, name, time):
    def enqueue(self, process):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail] = process
        # self.queue[self.tail].name = name
        # self.queue[self.tail].time = time
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        # self.queue[self.head].name = ""
        # self.queue[self.head].time = 0
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time,):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        name, time = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, \
                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].time
        my_queue.enqueue(my_queue.queue[my_queue.head])
        my_queue.dequeue()

    return current_time

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50010
        self.queue = [0] * self.length
        # counter = 0
        # while counter < self.length:
        #     self.queue.append(Process())
        #     counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    # def enqueue(self, name, time):
    def enqueue(self, process):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail] = process
        # self.queue[self.tail].name = name
        # self.queue[self.tail].time = time
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        # self.queue[self.head].name = ""
        # self.queue[self.head].time = 0
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time,):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        name, time = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, \
                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].time
        my_queue.enqueue(my_queue.queue[my_queue.head])
        my_queue.dequeue()

    return current_time

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 100010
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_full():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Overflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].name = name
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].time = time
            self.tail += 1

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_empty():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Underflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].name = ""
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].time = 0
            self.head += 1

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].name, current_time

    elif value > 0:

                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].time
        my_queue.dequeue()

def rrs(quantum, process):
    finished_process = []
    queue = Queue()
    current_time = 0

    for p in process:
       queue.enqueue(p)

    while queue.data:
        p_info = queue.dequeue()
        time = int(p_info[1])
        name = p_info[0]
        if time <= quantum:
            current_time += time
            finished_process.append((name, current_time))
        else:
            current_time += quantum
            queue.enqueue((name, time - quantum))
            
    return finished_process


class Queue:
    def __init__(self):
        self.data = []

    def enqueue(self, d):
        self.data.append(d)

    def dequeue(self):
        r = self.data[0]
        self.data = self.data[1:]
        return r

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50010
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail].name = name
        self.queue[self.tail].time = time
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.head].name = ""
        self.queue[self.head].time = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time, end_time_list):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        end_time_list.append([my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, current_time])
        # print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        name, time = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].name, \
                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head].time
        my_queue.dequeue()
        my_queue.enqueue(name, time)

    return current_time

        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50010
        self.queue = [0] * self.length
        # counter = 0
        # while counter < self.length:
        #     self.queue.append(Process())
        #     counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    # def enqueue(self, name, time):
    def enqueue(self, process):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail] = process
        # self.queue[self.tail].name = name
        # self.queue[self.tail].time = time
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        # self.queue[self.head].name = ""
        # self.queue[self.head].time = 0
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time

    if value <= 0:

        my_queue.enqueue(my_queue.queue[my_queue.head])

class MyQueue(object):

    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 50005
        self.queue = [0] * self.length
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    # def enqueue(self, name, time):
    def enqueue(self, process):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.tail] = process
        self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.length

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self.queue[self.head] = 0
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.length

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False

class Queue:
    def __init__(self, size=100005):
        self.size = size
        self.q = [None] * self.size
        self.head = 1
        self.tail = 1

    def is_empty(self):
        return self.head == self.tail

    def enqueue(self, obj):
        self.q[self.tail] = obj
        if self.tail == self.size - 1:
            self.tail = 0
        else:
            self.tail += 1

    def dequeue(self):
        if self.head == self.size - 1:
            self.head = 0
            return self.q[self.size - 1]
        else:
            self.head += 1
            return self.q[self.head - 1]

class MyQueue(object):
    """
    My Queue class

    Attributes:
        queue: queue
        head
        tail
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Constructor
        """
        self.length = 100010
        self.queue = []
        counter = 0
        while counter < self.length:
            self.queue.append(Process())
            counter += 1
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

    def enqueue(self, name, time):
        """enqueue method

        Args:
            name: enqueued process name
            time: enqueued process time

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_full():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Overflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].name = name
            self.queue[self.tail % self.length].time = time
            self.tail += 1

    def dequeue(self):
        """dequeue method

        Returns:
            None
        """
        if self.is_empty():
            print("[ERROR] Queue Underflow")
        else:
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].name = ""
            self.queue[self.head % self.length].time = 0
            self.head += 1

    def is_empty(self):
        """check queue is empty or not

        Returns:
            Bool
        """
        if self.head == self.tail:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def is_full(self):
        """chech whether queue is full or not"""
        if self.tail - self.head >= len(self.queue):
            return True
        else:
            return False


class Process(object):
    """process class
    """

    def __init__(self, name="", time=0):
        """constructor
        Args:
            name: name
            time: time
        """
        self.name = name
        self.time = time

    def forward_time(self, time):
        """time forward method

        Args:
            time: forward time interval

        Returns:
            remain time

        """
        self.time -= time
        return self.time


def time_forward(my_queue, interval, current_time):
    """

    Args:
        my_queue: queue
        interval: time step interval
        current_time: current time
    """

    value = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].forward_time(interval)
    if value <= 0:
        current_time += (interval + value)
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()


    elif value == 0:
        current_time += interval
        print my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].name, current_time
        my_queue.dequeue()

    elif value > 0:
        current_time += interval
        name, time = my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].name, \
                     my_queue.queue[my_queue.head % my_queue.length].time
        my_queue.dequeue()
        my_queue.enqueue(name, time)

    return current_time

    self.tail += 1

    for i in range(n):

        dq.append((name, time))

            dq.append((top[0], top[1] - q))
            cur_time += q
        else:
            print(top[0] + " " + str(cur_time+top[1]))
            cur_time += top[1]

N, qms = map(int, input().split())

raw_proc = [input() for i in range(N)]
queue = [{} for i in range(N+1)]
limit = N+1
for i in range(N):
    name, time = raw_proc[i].split()
    time = int(time)
    queue[i] = {"name": name, "time": time}

def enque(tail, p):
    queue[tail] = p
    tail = (tail+1) % limit
    return tail

def deque(head):
    proc = queue[head]
    head = (head+1) % limit
    return proc, head
